movementPatterns.name: Horizontal push
movementPatterns.description: Pressing resistance away from the torso.

movementPatterns.name: Hip hinge
movementPatterns.description: Hip-dominant movement with a stable spine.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.summary: A bodyweight horizontal press for chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Place hands just outside shoulder width and brace the trunk.
Lower the chest with elbows angled slightly back.
Press the floor away while keeping the body in one line.

exercises.name: Incline Push-up
exercises.summary: A reduced-load push-up performed against a stable raised surface.
instructions: Set hands on a stable bench.
Keep a straight line from head to heel.
Lower under control and press away.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.summary: A stable horizontal press with independent dumbbell loading.
instructions: Set shoulder blades against the bench.
Lower dumbbells beside the chest.
Press up without letting shoulders roll forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.summary: A supported single-arm row for the back and biceps.
instructions: Hinge forward, support the free hand and keep the spine neutral.
Pull the dumbbell to the hip with the elbow close.
Lower under control without rotating the torso.

exercises.name: Band Row
exercises.summary: A scalable horizontal pull using elastic resistance.
instructions: Anchor the band securely at torso height.
Brace and pull both hands toward the ribs.
Return slowly without shrugging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.summary: An overhead press for shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Start with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace the trunk and press overhead.
Lower smoothly to the start.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.summary: A shoulder isolation exercise using light dumbbells.
instructions: Hold dumbbells by the sides with soft elbows.
Raise arms to roughly shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
exercises.summary: A dumbbell elbow-flexion exercise for the biceps.
instructions: Stand tall with arms by the sides.
Curl without moving the upper arms.
Lower fully under control.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension
exercises.summary: An overhead dumbbell extension for the triceps.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead.
Bend elbows while keeping upper arms steady.
Extend without arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand around shoulder width and brace.
Sit down between the hips to a comfortable depth.
Drive through the feet to stand.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.summary: A front-loaded squat using one dumbbell.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell close to the chest.
Squat to a controlled, comfortable depth.
Stand while keeping the torso braced.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.summary: A split-stance lower-body exercise with a backward step.
instructions: Step one foot back into a stable stance.
Lower both knees to a comfortable range.
Push through the front foot to return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.summary: A loaded hip hinge for hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold dumbbells close to the thighs.
Push hips back with soft knees and a neutral spine.
Stand by driving the hips forward.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie down with feet planted near the hips.
Brace and lift the hips without arching the back.
Pause, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.summary: A standing plantar-flexion exercise for the calves.
instructions: Stand tall with light support available.
Rise onto the balls of the feet.
Pause and lower through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.summary: An anti-extension core hold from the forearms.
instructions: Place elbows below shoulders.
Brace and lift into a straight body line.
Breathe while keeping hips steady.

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Set the elbow directly below the shoulder.
Stack or stagger the feet.
Lift the hips and hold a straight line.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.summary: A supine core control exercise with alternating limbs.
instructions: Lie on the back with hips and knees bent.
Brace gently and extend opposite arm and leg.
Return without the lower back lifting.
